summary: Sports Entertainment Gaming Global Corp filed an 8-K reporting a Partnership and Integration Agreement with Polymarket for prediction market tech integration into its Sports.com platform. No equity or asset purchase, no price per share, premium, or deal value. Board recommendation and advisors not mentioned. Arrangement is a revenue-sharing API/SDK license with exclusivity terms, not a change-of-control event. This is a routine commercial agreement, not a special situation. Filing lacks acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring characteristics. Watch for regulatory compliance regarding predictive wagering; no risk-arb angle applies.
